label: defixs-finance.vercel.app
title: Defix-Finance | One-Stop DeFi Solution
reasons: A field named 'seedPhrase' is present in the bundle — no legitimate service asks users to input their seed phrase through a web page.
The page copy offers to 'rectify all strange wallet issues' and 'resolve missing or irregular balance issues', using these pretexts to coax visitors into entering their seed phrase.
The page references real wallet brands (Trust Wallet, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet) as if it provides official support for them, while 'Defix-Finance' is not affiliated with any of those services.

label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app
title: EVM Resolve
reasons: Page impersonates a Coinbase wallet connection flow via a hidden Coinbase Wallet SDK modal (`-cbwsdk-connect-dialog`) and QR code pairing to `walletlink.org`
All interactive elements (buttons, links) are redirected to a '/connect/' path that performs wallet connection, with copy like 'Restore your Account' and 'Get Started' directing users to connect

Page claims 'test transactions' with 'no real effects' but is structured to harvest wallet signatures via a fraudulent 'AI Rectifications' interface for operations like 'Assets Recovery' and 'Wallet Validation'

label: vibestreamoficial.github.io/cybervault
title: CyberVault - Marketplace de Cibersegurança
reasons: The page contains a checkout form labeled 'Checkout' that requests full credit card details including fields for card number ('Número do Cartão'), expiration ('Validade'), CVV, and personal identifiers like CPF/CNPJ.
The form is submitted to a local JavaScript function 'processCheckout(event)' with no evidence of a legitimate payment processor integration (no Stripe, PayPal, or bank redirect).

The site presents itself as a functional 'Marketplace de Cibersegurança' (Cybersecurity Marketplace) but is hosted on a GitHub Pages domain with placeholder content (e.g., '0+' tools/users) and a future-dated repository creation timestamp (2026-08-19).

label: ciceroyce12-ops.github.io/Aflaha_Hijab
